title: Lorcaserin
abstract:
#### **V. Dosing**  
1. Lorcaserin (Belviq) 10 mg orally twice daily
2. Belviq XR preparation available for once daily use in 2017
3. Stop medication if 5% weight loss is not achieved at 12 weeks
#### **VI. Adverse Effects**  
01. Cancer Risk
02. No associated valvulopathy  
1. Lorcaserin has 100 fold greater neurologic 5HT-2C affinity over cardiac valve 5HT-2B affinity
03. Well tolerated
04. More specific, and does not appear to carry same valvular heart disease risks as with fenfluramine
05. [Constipation](../../GI/Constipation/CnstptnInAdlts.htm)
06. [Cough](../../Lung/Sx/Cgh.htm)
07. [Dry Mouth](../../ENT/Sx/DryMth.htm)
08. [Fatigue](../../Rheum/Sx/Ftg.htm)
09. [Nausea](../../GI/Sx/Vmtng.htm)
10. [Hypoglycemia](../../Endo/Hypoglycemia/Hypglycm.htm)
#### **VII. Drug Interactions**  
1. [Serotonergic Medication](../../Psych/Pharm/SrtnSyndrm.htm)s (e.g.[SSRI](../../Psych/Pharm/SlctvSrtnRptkInhbtr.htm),[Dextromethorphan](../../Lung/Pharm/Dxtrmthrphn.htm))
